why: Both advisors make the same correct call: validate demand with paid pre-orders before spending two weeks on production. Advice 2 adds more that is useful: the legal disclosure (特定商取引法) the sales page will need, the admission that pre-orders can undercount demand for a course buyers can't see yet, and concrete go/stop tests tied to production cost. Its specific dates and thresholds are somewhat arbitrary, which is why it scores lower on clarity.
